description: This PHP source file defines the ReportGeneratorService class within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides methods for generating, retrieving, and manipulating reports, including handling header data, query building, and filtering logic for the HRM reports system.

classes.name: ReportGeneratorService
classes.description: A service class for generating and managing reports within the OrangeHRM system, including header data retrieval, report data querying, and report saving functionalities.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of ReportGeneratorDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: isPimReport
methods.description: Checks if the specified report ID corresponds to a PIM supposed report.

methods.name: getHeaderData
methods.description: Retrieves header data for a report by aggregating display fields and groups.

methods.name: getHeaderGroupsForDisplayFields
methods.description: Constructs header groupings for display fields based on display field groupings.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinitionByReportId
methods.description: Creates a Header object with metadata for a specific report.

methods.name: getNormalizedReportData
methods.description: Fetches report data according to filter parameters and normalizes DTO objects to primitive types or arrays.

methods.name: getReportDataCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of report data entries matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getReportDataQueryBuilder
methods.description: Builds the Doctrine query builder for fetching report data based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getHashKeyForFilterParamObject
methods.description: Generates a unique hash key for memoization of report data queries.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Applies sorting and pagination settings to the query builder.

methods.name: setJoinsToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds necessary JOIN clauses to the query builder based on alias dependencies.

methods.name: setJoinToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a specific JOIN clause to the query builder considering alias dependencies.

methods.name: savePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Saves a report with specified display fields, criteria, and include type, handling transactional integrity.

methods.name: getInitializedFilterFieldInstance
methods.description: Creates and initializes a filter field instance based on class name and selected filter field data.

methods.name: generateSelectedFilterFieldsByCriteria
methods.description: Generates filter field objects from given criteria array for report filtering.

methods.name: generateSelectedFilterFieldForIncludeEmployee
methods.description: Creates a filter field for including employees based on include type parameter.

methods.name: modifySelectedFilterFieldValues
methods.description: Modifies filter field values dynamically based on specific value modifiers.

methods.name: getDisplayFields
methods.description: Retrieves all display fields organized by groups, with localized labels.
